observations: Photos 0, 1 and 2: a long rear-wheel-drive automatic gearbox with a long tail housing and an output shaft at the end, still bolted to a V8 petrol engine with intake, hoses and wiring loom attached.
The assembly sits on the ground in a parts yard among other used engines and gearboxes; a dealer watermark ('GEARUP INC.') is on every photo.
The gearbox case is caked with dirt, dried leaves and debris, consistent with a used unit stored outdoors.
A metal cooler or dipstick line runs along the side of the gearbox in photo 2; the oil pan, bell housing bolts and ID tag are not shown.
No brand logo, transmission ID tag, part number or VIN plate is legible in any photo.
The listing names only a gearbox, but the photos show engine and gearbox together, so what is actually included is unclear.

identity.kind: used rear-wheel-drive automatic gearbox for a V8 van (seller says Ford Econoline E150/E250/E350)
read_from: photos 0, 1 and 2 gearbox shape bolted to a V8 engine; no tag legible

claims.claim: Gearbox for Ford Econoline E150 E250 E350 V8
claims.evidence: A rear-wheel-drive automatic gearbox on a V8 is shown, consistent with the claim, but no Ford mark, ID tag or part number is legible.
Photos 0 and 1 show a longitudinal gearbox with a rear tail housing and output shaft.

claims.claim: Foreign used, tokunbo, direct from Belgium
claims.evidence: Origin cannot be shown by photos; no shipping or import papers shown.
No clip of the gearbox running and shifting through gears.
No clip with sound of the unit running.
No odometer photo from the donor vehicle or any record.
No close-up of the pan gasket, case bolts and seals for sealant or tool marks.

risks.risk: Gearbox may slip, fail to shift or be internally damaged
risks.proof: Clip of the gearbox running on a test bench or in a vehicle, shifting through all gears and reverse
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, a core for rebuild

risks.risk: Gearbox may be the wrong type or not fit the Econoline V8
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the transmission ID tag or casting part number
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unidentified used automatic gearbox at the low end

risks.risk: Burnt fluid or metal in the pan from internal wear
risks.proof: Photo of fluid drawn on the dipstick on white paper and a photo of the pan underside

risks.risk: Previously opened or rebuilt, damaged case or broken mounts
risks.proof: Close-ups of the pan gasket, case bolts, bell housing and mounting points

risks.risk: Engine shown may or may not be part of the sale; torque converter may be missing
risks.proof: Photo of the gearbox alone, separated, showing the torque converter in place
risks.if_unproven: priced as gearbox only, without torque converter

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the transmission ID tag or part number
Clip of the gearbox running and shifting through all gears
Photo of the gearbox alone with torque converter fitted and a handwritten note carrying today's date
Close-ups of the pan gasket and case bolts
response.reason: The photos show a used rear-wheel-drive automatic gearbox on a V8, identifiable by type, so it can be priced at worst case as a non-working core of unconfirmed fitment; the ID tag and a running clip would raise it.
